strings.prompt.gate: Go out to the front yard
strings.objective.get_bearings: Don't rush. Biology hasn't started yet.
strings.objective.check_bag: Check your bag and find the textbook.
strings.objective.outside: You're outside. There's hardly anyone out here.
strings.objective.residential: The road seems to stretch on towards those blocks of flats.
strings.objective.animal: Something seems to be standing over there. Something green.
strings.overlay.expect_body: Nothing in this has happened. It is what you imagine.
strings.overlay.deny_body: The bell has not rung. Nobody has come in.
strings.objective.bell: The bell's gone. The lesson is about to start.
strings.objective.no_textbook: The biology textbook just isn't in your bag.
strings.end.slice.title: End of this build
strings.end.slice.body: You've crossed the whole school and gone past several buildings. Now you're standing beside the empty basketball court behind them. You can see a storeroom, a climbing frame and a bench.
strings.objective.alley: The alley is behind the building. There's a small iron gate at the end.
strings.objective.playground: There's hardly anyone in the yard. It feels very empty.
strings.prompt.gate_far: Go through the gap in the fence
strings.prompt.container_yard: Squeeze through the fence behind the container
strings.prompt.container_yard_out: Back through the gap to the schoolyard
strings.prompt.port: Climb into the box bound for the dock
strings.objective.free_period: N says you can study here or go out to the yard. Whether you go out is up to you.
strings.objective.stay_classroom: You've decided to stay in the classroom.
strings.objective.schoolyard: The yard is through that door on the ground floor. The ground floor has more than one door.
strings.prompt.yard_to_corridor: Go back in through the fire door
strings.menu.title: Title screen
strings.menu.save_unreadable: The save file could not be read, so there is nothing to continue. The file has not been deleted.
strings.menu.confirm_new_game: Your current progress and its save will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
strings.menu.confirm_new_game_broken: The unreadable save will be removed; the copy that was set aside is kept.
strings.menu.confirm_return_save: Your current position and progress will be saved before returning.
strings.menu.return_failed: The main menu could not be opened. You are still in the current game.
strings.menu.confirm_quit_checkpoint: Progress since the last save will be lost. Continue will load: {caption}.
strings.menu.confirm_quit_no_save: There is no readable save. If you return now, the next game starts from the beginning.
strings.menu.confirm_quit_failed: Your progress could not be saved. Return without saving?
strings.menu.new_game_failed.save_stage_failed: The new game did not start: the save file could not be moved aside.
strings.menu.new_game_failed.scene_change_failed: The new game did not start: the opening could not be loaded.
strings.menu.new_game_failed.staged_discard_fail: The new game did not start: the old save could not be removed.
strings.menu.new_game_failed.state_left: The new game did not start: the last run could not be cleared.
strings.menu.new_game_failed.unknown: The new game did not start.
strings.menu.new_game_failed.busy: A new game is already starting. Wait a moment, then try again.
strings.menu.new_game_failed.kept: Nothing was lost: your save and your progress are as they were.
strings.menu.new_game_failed.save_lost: The old save could not be put back. A copy is at {path}.
strings.settings.title: Settings
strings.settings.story_editor_note: When on, choose Story editor from the pause menu in-game. Drafts are stored separately from saves.
strings.settings.diagnostics_note: Exports versions, room, limited game state and recent events. No saves, dialogue text or personal paths. Nothing is sent. Review the file before sharing it yourself.
strings.settings.logs_opened: Asked the system to open the log folder.
strings.settings.logs_open_failed: Could not open the log folder. Try the path shown above.
strings.settings.diagnostics_export_partial: Saved {file}, but some history could not be kept or read.
strings.settings.diagnostics_export_failed: Could not write diagnostics. Check disk space and folder permissions.
strings.settings.clear_read_log_ask: Press again to forget every line read and option chosen.
strings.settings.read_log_clear_failed: The read log could not be saved.
strings.settings.capture_key: Press a key for “{action}”. Esc cancels.
strings.settings.capture_pad: Press a controller button for “{action}”. Esc cancels.
strings.settings.capture_timeout: No input arrived; the control was not changed.
strings.settings.conflict: That input is already used by “{action}”; nothing changed.
strings.settings.refused: That input cannot be used here; nothing changed.
strings.settings.touch_controls: Drag the left stick to move; near a target, tap Use on the right. Tap the ground or a target to walk there. Open the notebook from Pause.
strings.settings.save_failed: Settings were not saved. The switch has not changed. Try again.
strings.settings.save_failed_step: Settings were not saved ({step}). The switch has not changed. Try again.
strings.settings.session_only_note: Settings were not saved ({step}): this development run has the story editor on until it restarts.
strings.settings.hint_touch: Swipe to see more · Tap to change; changes are saved as you go
strings.journal.title: Notebook
strings.journal.subtitle: What you know, and how you know it.
strings.journal.caveat.all: Seen, heard, remembered, imagined: they need not tell the same story.
strings.journal.caveat.observed: What you saw yourself. Seeing is not the same as understanding.
strings.journal.caveat.reported: What someone told you. It only proves they said it.
strings.journal.caveat.recalled: What you remember. Memory quietly rewrites itself.
strings.journal.caveat.imagined: What you imagined. It is not something that happened.
strings.journal.caveat.compare: Read two related notes together. Neither settles the question by itself.
strings.journal.empty: Nothing written down yet. Look around; talk to people.
strings.journal.empty_compare: No pair to compare yet. Look around and listen to what people say.
strings.journal.comparison.duty_sheets.title: Two duty sheets
strings.journal.comparison.duty_sheets.question: Could the blank master and the sheet with a repeated day be related?
strings.journal.comparison.animal_picture.title: The animal and the textbook
strings.journal.comparison.animal_picture.questi: What can a caption you no longer remember tell you about the animal?
